sn47.36:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these four establishments of mindfulness.
sn47.36:1.3: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body …
sn47.36:1.6: phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.36:1.8: these four establishments of mindfulness have been developed and cultivated, one of two fruits may be expected:
sn47.36:1.9: either final knowledge in this very life or, if there is a residue of clinging, the state of nonreturning.”
